turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did the package for the Radxa Rock 5C arrive yet? I want to get Alfie running before the weekend.
I don't have access to real-time shipping status, but you can check your tracking link. Did you order the 4GB or 8GB version?
4GB. The Radxa Rock 5C is the SBC used for Alfie, so it needs to be compact enough to fit inside the case I 3D printed.
Got it. The Rock 5C is quite small, so that should work. Have you prepared the SD card image?
Not yet. I'm struggling with the Wi-Fi module setup on my main laptop first. It keeps disconnecting every 5 minutes.
That sounds frustrating. Have you tried disabling power management for the Wi-Fi adapter in the device manager?
I'll give that a try. Also, what are you doing for dinner? I was thinking about ordering Thai food.
As an AI, I don't eat, but I can recommend a good Pad See Ew place nearby if you'd like.
Maybe later. I need to focus on getting Alfie online. Thanks for the tip on the Wi-Fi.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need help with the boot process once the board arrives.
